summary.content:
Today's selection covers 84 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 49 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic is launching a new think tank amid Pentagon blacklist fight
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New KadNap botnet hijacks ASUS routers to fuel cybercrime proxy network
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 63 articles published in the last 24 hours
